hello hello
if you're here that means you signed up to be a night guard at the hero base of awesomeness ad coolness or something like that definitely!
congratulations on getting the job!
this will be your most interactive job yet, involving lots of time and power management
we welcome you to the faz- i mean wolfen co. family!
ok so first things first
the animatronics WILL wander around at night
so lets get to know the animatronics
so first up we have wolfenwitch, the mascot.
he was sleeping, then you woke him up, so he dislikes you.
when he comes on the right side, close the door on him.
v0 is the exact same, but in the left door.
kirbo teleports around for a little bit before entering your office hallway.
once he's there, shine a light on him. he dislikes the light. we never found out why, though.
previous guards have reported a "ghost-like version of kirbo", whatever that means.
they say that he will appear in our office, but dislikes freddy fazbear. so wear the mask, just in case.
Also, Blacky will run to the right door, so shut the door on him.
Same with Ambush, but hill come on the left or right doors.
Even though, Ambush will sometimes rebound to the same door.
A-400 will come to the office, wear the mask on him too or A-400 will waste your power and have a chance to send ambush but hill come at the door once.
Although, if there is a apple on the cams, it will waste your power, click on it in the cams.
Don't look at A-100, hill come and kill you.
For TheUtimate, He may break out of his cell as we did not improve his containment cell.
If he ever gets out, do not worry as his main focus seems to not be you. However if he ever finds you
he will most likely toy with you and manipulate you to do stuff like wasting power. Make sure to follow along or... well yeah.
Also, wind up the music box because yeah.
also a rando guy in blue who is addicted to twiddle fingers will appear randomly.
he's just annoying
there's also roach
she's really cute
but unfortunately she can distract you from dealing with the others
and there's mr bambi...........
i don't really know about him
all i really know is he's really aggressive
and there's also the ad's
we do not talk about the ad's
There is more animatronics but I'll let you figure them all out yourself.
also roach and mr bambi are not animatronics. they just showed up one day. we're still counting them as one though.
alright, that's it for now.
good luck

input0: Connection terminated.
I'm-a sorry to interrupt you Mario, If you even still remember that name.
But I'm afraid you've been misinformed.
You are not here to receive a gift, nor have you been called here by the individual you assume, although, you have indeed been called.
You have all been called here. Into a labyrinth of sounds and smells, misdirection and misfortune. A labyrinth with no exit, a maze with no prize.
You don't even-a realize that you are trapped.
Your desire for blood has driven you in endless circles, chasing the cries of remixers in some unseen chamber always seeming so near, yet somehow out of reach.
But you will never find them, none of you will. This is-a where your story ends.
And to-a you, my brave cyborg, who somehow found this job listing not intended for you.
Although there was a way out planned for you, I have a feeling that's not what-a you want. I have a feeling that you are right where you want to be.
I'm-a remaining as well, I'm-a nearby.
This place will-a not be remembered, and the memory of everything that started this can finally begin to fade away. As the agony of every tragedy should.
And-a to you OCs trapped in the corridors: Be-a still and give up your spirits, they don't belong to you.
For-a most of you, I believe there is-a peace and perhaps more waiting for you after the smoke clears.
Although, for-a one of you "OCs", the darkest pit of-a Hell has opened to swallow you whole, so-a don't keep the devil waiting, old friend.
My brother, if-a you can hear me, I knew you would return as well. It's in your nature to protect the innocent.
I'm-a sorry that on that day, the day you were shut out and left to die, no one was there to lift you up into their arms the way you lifted others into yours. And-a then, what became of you.
I should-a have known-a you wouldn't be content to disappear, not my brother. I couldn't-a save you then, so let me save you now.
It's-a time to rest. For you, and for those you have carried in your arms.
This ends for all of us.
End communication.
